In parallel, the team is executing a CEC-funded pilot-scale sulfur TES unit at Searles Valley Minerals’ Mojave Desert facility, directly supporting their Zero Net Energy and industrial decarbonization goals. These milestones demonstrate meaningful market validation and customer traction, key steps toward commercialization. Building on the successful development of sulfur TES up to 300 °C, Element 16’s next R&D milestone is extending the operating temperature range to 400 °C and above. The goal is to evaluate feasibility, select materials and components based on corrosion testing at these higher operating temperatures, and design and test a prototype TES system capable of charging to 400 °C or above for integration with existing parabolic trough systems. This system will ultimately provide heat across a broad range of industrial applications (100–350 °C). Products: Page 83 of 87 DE-EE0009329 Element 16 Technologies, Inc. 1.
